examTags: 词汇·动词搭配
语言运用·表达节日与纪念活动
grammar: v. 庆祝；庆贺；celebrate—celebrated—celebrated—celebrating。celebrate 后直接接节日、生日或事件。
collocations: celebrate a birthday; celebrate a festival; celebrate with family。
commonMistake: celebrate 后直接接庆祝的事情，不说 celebrate for a birthday。

example.english: We celebrate Grandma's birthday with a family dinner.
example.chinese: 我们和家人一起吃晚饭庆祝奶奶的生日。

application.prompt: Our school is having a party to ___ its 30th birthday. A. celebrate B. collect
application.solution: A。解析：为生日举办聚会是 celebrate（庆祝）。

examTags: 词汇·名词与动词
阅读·理解情感与事件
grammar: n. 惊奇；意外之事；v. 使惊讶。名词可数，复数 surprises；形容词 surprised 描述人的感受，surprising 描述令人惊讶的事。
collocations: a birthday surprise; surprise someone; be surprised at/by sth.。
commonMistake: surprise 作名词时单数前常用 a；surprised 描述人的感受，surprising 描述事情的特点。

example.english: The birthday cake was a lovely surprise for my sister.
example.chinese: 生日蛋糕给我妹妹带来了一个可爱的惊喜。

application.prompt: No one told Leo about the party, so it was a ___ for him. A. surprise B. list
application.solution: A。解析：事先不知道、让人意外的事情是 surprise（惊喜/意外）。

examTags: 语法·不定代词
阅读·理解不确定事物指代
grammar: pron. 某事；某物。通常用于肯定句；作主语时谓语常用单数，形容词放在 something 后面。
collocations: something special; something to eat; something about the party。
commonMistake: 形容词放在 something 后面，如 something interesting；不定代词作主语时通常用单数谓语。

example.english: I want to buy something special for my dad.
example.chinese: 我想给爸爸买一件特别的东西。

application.prompt: The bag is not empty, but I cannot see what is inside. There is ___ in it. A. something B. nothing
application.solution: A。解析：题目说明包里有东西但看不清是什么，用 something；nothing 表示什么都没有。

examTags: 词汇·购物场景与名词搭配
阅读·理解价格与促销信息
grammar: n. 出售；销售；特价销售活动。可数，复数 sales；for sale 表示待售，on sale 可表示正在销售或特价销售（依英语地区和语境而异）。
collocations: for sale; on sale; have a sale; a book sale。
commonMistake: sale 是名词，sell 是动词；for sale 表示“待售”，on sale 在不同地区可指“在售”或“特价”。

example.english: The shop has a sale on birthday cards this week.
example.chinese: 这家商店本周生日贺卡打折促销。

application.prompt: The shop sells some toys at lower prices this week. It is having a ___. A. sale B. kilo
application.solution: A。解析：商店降价销售的促销活动是 sale。

examTags: 词汇·重量单位与数量表达
听读·获取购物数量信息
grammar: n. 千克；公斤，是 kilogram 的常用简称。可数，复数 kilos；常用 a kilo of + 食物/物品。
collocations: a kilo of apples; two kilos of rice; half a kilo。
commonMistake: kilo 是可数单位，two 后用复数 kilos；a kilo of 后可接不可数名词，如 rice。

example.english: Please buy a kilo of oranges for the party.
example.chinese: 请为聚会买一公斤橙子。

application.prompt: We need one ___ of apples for the fruit salad. A. kilo B. kilos
application.solution: A。解析：one 后用单数 kilo；a kilo of 表示一公斤。

examTags: 词汇·食物主题与不可数名词
阅读·理解购物清单
grammar: n. 酸奶；通常作不可数名词。yoghurt 是常见的英式拼写变体；表示一份时可说 a pot/cup of yogurt。
collocations: some yogurt; a cup of yogurt; yogurt and fruit。
commonMistake: yogurt 通常不可数，不说 yogurts 表示酸奶这种食物；可用 a cup of yogurt 表示一杯。

example.english: We put some yogurt and fruit on the birthday table.
example.chinese: 我们在生日餐桌上放了一些酸奶和水果。

application.prompt: There is ___ yogurt in the fridge for breakfast. A. some B. many
application.solution: A。解析：yogurt 通常不可数，用 some 修饰；many 修饰可数名词复数。

examTags: 词汇·名词与形容词
听读·计算与核对总价
grammar: n. 总数；总额；adj. 总的；全部的。常用 in total、a total of；结账时可说 The total is ...。
collocations: in total; a total of ten; the total price。
commonMistake: total 可作名词或形容词；the total 是“总数/总额”，total price 中 total 修饰名词 price。

example.english: The total for the cake and candles is 80 yuan.
example.chinese: 蛋糕和蜡烛的总价是80元。

application.prompt: The cake costs 60 yuan and the candles cost 10 yuan. The total ___ 70 yuan. A. is B. are
application.solution: A。解析：the total 作主语表示一个总额，谓语用单数 is。

examTags: 词汇·购物与价格表达
语言运用·询问商品价格
grammar: n. 价格；可数，复数 prices。可问 What's the price of ...?；日常询价也常用 How much is/are ...?。
collocations: the price of a cake; a high/low price; price tag。
commonMistake: price 表示“价格”，expensive 表示“昂贵的”；询问价格可说 What's the price? 或 How much is it?

example.english: The price of this chocolate cake is 120 yuan.
example.chinese: 这个巧克力蛋糕的价格是120元。

application.prompt: You want to ask how much the balloon costs. What is the ___ of the balloon? A. price B. language
application.solution: A。解析：商品的价格是 price。

examTags: 词汇·食物主题与可数性
阅读·理解购物清单
grammar: n. 巧克力；通常作不可数名词，也可指一块巧克力糖而作可数名词。a bar/piece of chocolate 表示一块巧克力。
collocations: a bar of chocolate; chocolate cake; some chocolate。
commonMistake: 表示巧克力这种食物通常不可数，可说 some chocolate；一块用 a piece/bar of chocolate。

example.english: Dad puts chocolate on top of the birthday cake.
example.chinese: 爸爸在生日蛋糕上放了巧克力。

application.prompt: We need ___ chocolate to make the cake. A. some B. many
application.solution: A。解析：这里的 chocolate 指巧克力食材，通常不可数，用 some。

examTags: 词汇·名词与动词
写作·整理购物和任务信息
grammar: n. 名单；清单；v. 列出。名词可数，复数 lists；动词 list—listed—listed。
collocations: make a list; a shopping list; list the names。
commonMistake: list 可作名词或动词：make a list（列清单），list the items（把物品列出来）。

example.english: I made a list of food for the birthday party.
example.chinese: 我列了一张生日聚会食物清单。

application.prompt: Please ___ the three things we need to buy. A. list B. lists
application.solution: A。解析：please 引导祈使句，用动词原形 list。

examTags: 语法·物主表达
语言运用·表达个人所有
grammar: adj./pron. 自己的；本人的。常用物主限定词 + own + 名词，如 my own room；on one's own 表示独自。
collocations: my own birthday; her own idea; on my own。
commonMistake: own 前常有 my/your/his 等物主限定词：my own book；不要说 mine own book（现代普通用法）。

example.english: I made my own birthday card for Mum.
example.chinese: 我给妈妈做了自己的生日贺卡。

application.prompt: Lucy made the card without help. She made it on her ___. A. own B. own's
application.solution: A。解析：on her own 表示“独自地、靠自己”；own's 不是这个固定表达的形式。

examTags: 词汇·名词搭配
阅读·理解举例与说明
grammar: n. 例子；范例；可数，复数 examples。for example 常用于引出例子，通常与前面的说明用逗号隔开。
collocations: for example; an example of; set a good example。
commonMistake: 常说 for example（例如）；example 是可数名词，单数前需要 a/an/the 等限定词。

example.english: For example, a balloon can make a room look festive.
example.chinese: 例如，气球可以让房间看起来有节日气氛。

application.prompt: Fruit is a healthy snack. An apple is one ___. A. example B. total
application.solution: A。解析：苹果是健康零食的一个例子，example 表示“例子”。

examTags: 词汇·语言名称与可数名词
语言运用·谈论交流方式
grammar: n. 语言；可数，复数 languages。表示使用某种语言常说 speak + 语言名称，如 speak English。
collocations: a foreign language; body language; speak another language。
commonMistake: language 是可数名词，单数前通常有 a/the；语言名称本身首字母大写，如 English、French。

example.english: English is the main language in our class today.
example.chinese: 今天英语是我们班主要使用的语言。

application.prompt: French is a ___, not a kind of food. A. language B. balloon
application.solution: A。解析：French（法语）是一种 language（语言）。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与词根
阅读·理解国家间交流信息
grammar: adj. 国际的；由 inter-（相互、在……之间）+ national 构成。常修饰 school、event、language 等名词。
collocations: an international school; an international event; international students。
commonMistake: international 是形容词，通常放在名词前；注意和 national（国家的、全国的）区分。

example.english: Our city holds an international food festival every year.
example.chinese: 我们城市每年举办国际美食节。

application.prompt: Students from many countries study at this school. It is an ___ school. A. international B. national
application.solution: A。解析：有来自许多国家的学生，符合 international（国际的）。

examTags: 词汇·动词与名词多义
阅读·理解评分与纪念活动
grammar: v. 做记号；纪念；给……打分；n. 记号；分数。动词规则变化 mark—marked—marked。
collocations: mark a date on the calendar; mark an anniversary; get a high mark。
commonMistake: mark 作动词可表示“做标记、纪念或打分”；作名词可表示“记号、分数”，需看搭配判断。

example.english: The school marks its 50th birthday with a concert.
example.chinese: 学校用一场音乐会纪念建校50周年。

application.prompt: The school holds a special event for its 100th year. The event helps ___ this anniversary. A. mark B. weigh
application.solution: A。解析：mark an anniversary 表示“纪念一个周年”。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与词根
阅读·理解国家和民族信息
grammar: adj. 国家的；民族的；通常修饰名词。名词形式 nation 表示“国家”，nationality 表示“国籍”。
collocations: national flag; national holiday; national team。
commonMistake: national 是形容词，常修饰名词；不要与 international（国际的）混淆。

example.english: People hang the national flag on the holiday.
example.chinese: 人们在节日里挂起国旗。

application.prompt: A flag that represents one country is its ___ flag. A. national B. international
application.solution: A。解析：代表一个国家的旗帜是 national flag（国旗）。

examTags: 词汇·熟词多义与动词词形
阅读·根据句意判断创建行为
grammar: v. 创立；创建。此义的变化是 found—founded—founded；注意它与 find 的过去式 found（找到）同形，但词义和动词变化不同。
collocations: found a school; found a club; be founded in 2000。
commonMistake: found 表“创立”时过去式为 founded；find 的过去式虽然也拼作 found，但表示“找到”。

example.english: A group of students plans to found a reading club.
example.chinese: 一群学生计划创立一个阅读社。

application.prompt: The students want to start a new club at school. They plan to ___ a science club. A. found B. find
application.solution: A。解析：start/create a new club 表示创立社团，用 found；find 表示找到。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与复数
阅读·识别生日布置物品
grammar: n. 气球；可数，复数 balloons。可说 a balloon、blow up a balloon 或 a balloon filled with air。
collocations: a birthday balloon; blow up balloons; a balloon party decoration。
commonMistake: balloon 是可数名词，单数前要有限定词；复数直接加 -s：balloons。

example.english: We put blue balloons around the birthday table.
example.chinese: 我们在生日餐桌周围放了蓝色气球。

application.prompt: We need six ___ to decorate the room. A. balloons B. balloon
application.solution: A。解析：six 后接可数名词复数 balloons。

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
语言运用·食物与聚会
grammar: 可数名词，表示比萨饼；复数通常为 pizzas。表示一部分时可说 a slice of pizza。
collocations: a pizza；a slice of pizza；pizza party；order pizza
commonMistake: 表示一个完整比萨时用 a pizza；pizza 作食物泛称时也常作不可数名词。

example.english: We order two pizzas for the birthday party.
example.chinese: 我们为生日派对订了两个比萨。

application.prompt: The whole class shares three ___ at lunch. (pizza)
application.solution: pizzas

examTags: 词汇构词·形容词后缀 -ful
语言运用·表达意义与情感
grammar: 形容词，表示重要的、有意义的；由 meaning 加后缀 -ful 构成。比较时常用 more meaningful。
collocations: a meaningful gift；a meaningful conversation；a meaningful day
commonMistake: meaningful 是形容词，修饰名词或放在 be 等系动词后；meaning 是名词，表示“意义”。

example.english: A handwritten card can be a meaningful birthday gift.
example.chinese: 一张手写卡片可以是一份有意义的生日礼物。

application.prompt: The gift has a special story and is important to me. It is ___.
application.solution: meaningful

examTags: 语法知识·名词与动词
语言运用·网络信息与邮寄
grammar: 可作名词，表示帖子或邮政；也可作动词，表示发布信息或邮寄。动词过去式和过去分词为 posted。
collocations: post a photo online；write a post；post a letter；post office
commonMistake: post 作动词可表示在线发布或邮寄；根据宾语和语境判断具体意思，如 post a photo online。

example.english: I post one birthday photo on our class page each year.
example.chinese: 我每年都会在班级主页上发布一张生日照片。

application.prompt: After the party, Ella ___ three photos online. (post)
application.solution: posted

examTags: 语法知识·名词与动词
语言运用·沟通与联系
grammar: 可作名词，表示联系或联系人；也可作动词，表示联系某人。过去式和过去分词为 contacted。
collocations: contact a friend；contact details；keep in contact with sb
commonMistake: contact 作动词时可直接接人，不加 with，如 contact your cousin；作名词时可说 get in contact with。

example.english: Please contact your cousin before you choose a party date.
example.chinese: 选定派对日期前，请联系你的表亲。

application.prompt: Please ___ your aunt to ask what time she can come. (contact)
application.solution: contact

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
阅读能力·理解象征含义
grammar: 可数名词，表示象征或符号；复数为 symbols。常用 a symbol of 表示“……的象征”。
collocations: a symbol of peace；a national symbol；a mathematical symbol
commonMistake: 常用结构 a symbol of + 名词；symbol 指代表某种含义的事物或标记。

example.english: The candle is a symbol of hope on the birthday card.
example.chinese: 生日卡片上的蜡烛象征着希望。

application.prompt: A heart is often used as a ___ of love. (symbol / village)
application.solution: symbol

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
语言运用·地点与社区
grammar: 可数名词，表示村庄或村镇；复数为 villages。
collocations: a small village；village life；in the village；a village school
commonMistake: village 的复数是 villages；词尾 -ge 后直接加 -s。

example.english: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the lake.
example.chinese: 我的祖父母住在湖边一个安静的村庄里。

application.prompt: A small community in the countryside is a ___.
application.solution: village

examTags: 语法知识·不规则动词
语言运用·成长与变化
grammar: 动词，表示成长、长大或增长；不规则变化为 grow—grew—grown。grow up 表示长大成人。
collocations: grow up；grow taller；grow quickly；grow flowers
commonMistake: grow 的过去式是 grew，过去分词是 grown；不要把 growed 当作过去式。

example.english: My little brother wants to grow taller before next year.
example.chinese: 我弟弟想在明年之前长高一些。

application.prompt: The children have ___ a lot since last year. (grow)
application.solution: grown

examTags: 语法知识·不规则动词
语言运用·生日祝愿与动作
grammar: 动词，表示吹或刮；不规则变化为 blow—blew—blown。
collocations: blow out candles；blow your nose；the wind blows
commonMistake: blow 的过去式是 blew，过去分词是 blown；blow out candles 表示吹灭蜡烛。

example.english: Maya makes a wish and blows out the candles.
example.chinese: 玛雅许了个愿，然后吹灭蜡烛。

application.prompt: Make a wish and ___ out the candles on your cake. (blow)
application.solution: blow

examTags: 语法知识·动词后接动词-ing
语言运用·表达喜好与体验
grammar: 动词，表示喜欢或享受；后接名词、代词或动词-ing形式，也可用于 enjoy yourself。
collocations: enjoy a party；enjoy reading；enjoy yourself；enjoy the music
commonMistake: enjoy 后接动词时用 -ing 形式，如 enjoy dancing；不说 enjoy to dance。

example.english: We enjoy playing games at birthday parties.
example.chinese: 我们喜欢在生日派对上玩游戏。

application.prompt: I enjoy ___ songs with my friends. (sing)
application.solution: singing

examTags: 语法知识·名词与形容词辨析
语言运用·描述身高与高度
grammar: 名词，表示身高或高度；常用 the height of...。描述人有多高常用 tall，描述物体高度可用 high。
collocations: the height of a person；in height；a height of two metres
commonMistake: height 是名词；询问身高常说 How tall...?，回答可用 be + 数字 + tall。

example.english: The height of the birthday cake is about twenty centimetres.
example.chinese: 这个生日蛋糕大约有二十厘米高。

application.prompt: How tall is your cousin? His ___ is 1.6 metres. (height / high)
application.solution: height

examTags: 语法知识·时间副词与形容词
词汇辨析·late 与 later
grammar: 可作副词，表示后来或以后；也可作形容词，表示较后的。常见表达有 see you later 和 later this month。
collocations: see you later；later today；later this month；at a later time
commonMistake: later 表示“以后/后来”；late 常表示“迟到的/晚的”，如 arrive late。

example.english: We can choose the birthday gift later today.
example.chinese: 我们今天晚些时候可以选生日礼物。

application.prompt: I'll call you ___, after my music lesson. (later / late)
application.solution: later

examTags: 语法知识·人称代词宾格
阅读能力·理解人物关系从句
grammar: who 的宾格形式，较正式地用作动词或介词的宾语；口语疑问句中常用 who 代替 whom。
collocations: to whom；with whom；the person whom I called
commonMistake: 介词后用宾格 whom，如 to whom；日常口语中也常把介词放句末并用 who。

example.english: The cousin to whom I sent a card lives nearby.
example.chinese: 我寄了贺卡给那位表亲，他/她住在附近。

application.prompt: The friend to ___ I gave the invitation is coming to the party. (who / whom)
application.solution: whom

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与时间介词
语言运用·日期与庆祝
grammar: 可数名词，表示生日；复数为 birthdays。表示在某人生日那天常用 on one's birthday。
collocations: birthday party；birthday cake；birthday card；on my birthday
commonMistake: 表示生日当天通常说 on my birthday；表示年龄时用 be + 数字 + years old。

example.english: On her birthday, Ana invites her cousins for lunch.
example.chinese: 安娜生日那天会邀请表亲们来吃午饭。

application.prompt: The day each year that celebrates when someone was born is their ___.
application.solution: birthday

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
语言运用·日期与时间
grammar: 可数名词，表示月；复数为 months。一年有 twelve months。
collocations: next month；last month；this month；a month later
commonMistake: month 的复数是 months；不要漏掉复数词尾 -s。

example.english: My birthday is in the same month as my sister's.
example.chinese: 我的生日和姐姐/妹妹的生日在同一个月份。

application.prompt: There are twelve ___ in a year. (month)
application.solution: months

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
语言运用·礼物与表达心意
grammar: 可数名词，表示礼物或天赋；复数为 gifts。表示“给某人礼物”可说 give sb a gift 或 give a gift to sb。
collocations: a birthday gift；give/receive a gift；a gift for you
commonMistake: gift 是可数名词，表示一份礼物时要有 a/the/物主代词等限定词。

example.english: My brother gives me a book as a birthday gift.
example.chinese: 我哥哥/弟弟送我一本书作为生日礼物。

application.prompt: I wrapped a small ___ for my friend's birthday. (gift)
application.solution: gift

examTags: 语法知识·可数名词与复数
语言运用·庆祝活动
grammar: 可数名词，表示聚会或派对；复数为 parties，变复数时 y 改为 -ies。
collocations: birthday party；have a party；party games；party invitation
commonMistake: party 的复数为 parties，不是 partys；表示参加聚会常说 go to a party。

example.english: We play music games at my cousin's birthday party.
example.chinese: 我们在表亲的生日派对上玩音乐游戏。

application.prompt: We invite friends, eat cake, and play games at a birthday ___.
application.solution: party

examTags: 语法知识·不规则动词
语言运用·购物与赠礼
grammar: 动词，表示买；不规则变化为 buy—bought—bought。常用 buy sth for sb 或 buy sb sth。
collocations: buy a gift；buy sth for a friend；buy sb a cake
commonMistake: buy 的过去式是 bought；表示“给某人买某物”可说 buy sb sth 或 buy sth for sb。

example.english: Mum buys a fruit cake for my birthday each year.
example.chinese: 妈妈每年都会为我生日买一个水果蛋糕。

application.prompt: Mum ___ a cake for the party yesterday. (buy)
application.solution: bought

examTags: 词汇·名词与动词
阅读·购物场景理解
grammar: n. 商店；可数，复数 shops；v. 购物，shop—shopped—shopped—shopping。常说 go shopping 或 shop for sth.。
collocations: a book shop; shop for food; go shopping。
commonMistake: shop 可作“商店”或“购物”；表示去购物常说 go shopping，不说 go shop。

example.english: My aunt shops for fruit at the market every Saturday.
example.chinese: 我阿姨每周六在市场买水果。

application.prompt: My uncle works in a flower ___. A. shop B. shopping
application.solution: A。解析：flower shop 表示“花店”；shopping 是“购物”。

examTags: 词汇·不规则名词复数
阅读·人物信息理解
grammar: n. 女人；可数，复数 women，是不规则变化；woman 和 women 的中间元音发音不同。
collocations: a young woman; women and children; a businesswoman。
commonMistake: woman 的复数是 women，不是 womans；one woman，two women。

example.english: The woman at the door is my teacher's sister.
example.chinese: 门口那位女士是我老师的姐姐。

application.prompt: There is one adult female in the photo. She is a ___. A. woman B. women
application.solution: A。解析：one 后用单数 woman；women 是复数。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与复数
阅读·理解生日活动信息
grammar: n. 蜡烛；可数，复数 candles。生日时常把蜡烛插在蛋糕上。
collocations: light a candle; blow out the candles; a birthday cake with candles。
commonMistake: candle 是可数名词，单数前通常需要 a/the；多个生日蜡烛用 candles。

example.english: Mum puts eight candles on my birthday cake.
example.chinese: 妈妈在我的生日蛋糕上插了八根蜡烛。

application.prompt: Make a wish, then blow out the birthday ___. A. candles B. dolls
application.solution: A。解析：生日蛋糕上的蜡烛可以吹灭，candle 的复数是 candles。

examTags: 语法·一般将来时
听读·理解承诺与计划
grammar: modal v. 将要；会。will 后接动词原形；各种人称都用 will，否定式为 will not/won't。
collocations: will come; will have a party; won't forget。
commonMistake: will 后接动词原形，不加 to 或第三人称 -s：will eat，不说 will eats。

example.english: I will call you after the birthday party.
example.chinese: 生日聚会后我会给你打电话。

application.prompt: I promise I ___ bring a card tomorrow. A. will B. did
application.solution: A。解析：tomorrow 表示将来，承诺将做的事用 will + 动词原形。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与冠词
阅读·理解食物清单
grammar: n. 蛋；鸡蛋；可数，复数 eggs。单数前通常用 an，因 egg 以元音音素开头。
collocations: an egg; boil an egg; a dozen eggs。
commonMistake: 单数 egg 前用 an：an egg；复数 eggs 直接加 -s。

example.english: We need an egg to make the birthday cake.
example.chinese: 我们做生日蛋糕需要一个鸡蛋。

application.prompt: A hen lays ___. Choose the correct phrase for one: A. an egg B. a eggs
application.solution: A。解析：egg 是元音音素开头的单数可数名词，用 an。

examTags: 词汇·不可数名词与量词
阅读·理解饮食信息
grammar: n. 果汁；通常作不可数名词。表示一杯果汁可说 a glass of juice；果汁种类也可用 juices。
collocations: some orange juice; a glass of juice; fruit juice。
commonMistake: juice 通常不可数，不说 a juice 表示一杯；可说 a glass of juice。

example.english: There is some apple juice on the table.
example.chinese: 桌上有一些苹果汁。

application.prompt: How much ___ would you like with your cake? A. juice B. eggs
application.solution: A。解析：how much 修饰不可数名词，juice 通常不可数。

examTags: 词汇·不可数名词与量词
阅读·理解食物与饮品信息
grammar: n. 牛奶；通常作不可数名词。可用 a glass/bottle/carton of milk 表示一杯、一瓶或一盒牛奶。
collocations: a glass of milk; some milk; milk and cookies。
commonMistake: milk 通常不可数，不说 two milks；需要计量时说 two glasses of milk。

example.english: My little brother drinks a glass of milk every morning.
example.chinese: 我弟弟每天早上喝一杯牛奶。

application.prompt: There is ___ milk in the bottle. A. some B. many
application.solution: A。解析：milk 通常不可数，用 some 修饰；many 修饰可数名词复数。

examTags: 词汇·食物主题与名词可数性
阅读·理解生日零食信息
grammar: n. 糖果；美式英语中通常作不可数名词，也可指一颗糖果而作可数名词；英式英语常说 sweets。
collocations: some candy; a piece of candy; candy shop。
commonMistake: 表示糖果这种食物时 candy 常作不可数名词；英式英语更常用 sweets。

example.english: We put some candy in small bags for the guests.
example.chinese: 我们把一些糖果装进小袋子送给客人。

application.prompt: The children share ___ candy after the party. A. some B. many
application.solution: A。解析：这里 candy 指糖果，通常作不可数名词，用 some。

examTags: 词汇·名词与不规则动词
语言运用·表达饮食与邀请
grammar: v. 喝；n. 饮料；一杯饮品。动词变化 drink—drank—drunk；名词可数，复数 drinks。
collocations: drink water; have a drink; a cold drink。
commonMistake: drink 作动词时过去式是 drank、过去分词是 drunk；作名词表示“一杯饮料”时可数。

example.english: Would you like a cold drink with your cake?
example.chinese: 你想配蛋糕喝一杯冷饮吗？

application.prompt: After the game, I had a cold ___. A. drink B. eat
application.solution: A。解析：a 后需要名词；drink 可指一杯饮料。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与节日表达
写作·书写祝福信息
grammar: n. 卡片；厚纸片；可数，复数 cards。生日贺卡常说 birthday card 或 greeting card。
collocations: a birthday card; write a card; a card for my friend。
commonMistake: card 是可数名词，单数前要有 a/the 或物主限定词；“一张卡片”是 a card。

example.english: I wrote a birthday card for my cousin.
example.chinese: 我给表妹写了一张生日贺卡。

application.prompt: Write “Happy Birthday” inside a ___. A. card B. candle
application.solution: A。解析：生日祝福通常写在 card（卡片）上。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与玩具主题
阅读·理解礼物信息
grammar: n. 玩偶；玩具娃娃；可数，复数 dolls。常与 play with 或 give sb. a doll 搭配。
collocations: a toy doll; play with a doll; a doll's dress。
commonMistake: doll 是可数名词，单数前要有限定词；复数直接加 -s：dolls。

example.english: My niece received a doll for her birthday.
example.chinese: 我侄女生日时收到一个玩偶。

application.prompt: The toy has a face, hair and clothes, and children can play with it. It is a ___. A. doll B. juice
application.solution: A。解析：像小人一样可供孩子玩的玩具是 doll（玩偶）。

examTags: 词汇·称谓与礼貌表达
文化意识·姓名称呼格式
grammar: n. 夫人；太太；已婚女性的礼貌称呼，通常放在姓氏前，如 Mrs Green。美式书写也常写 Mrs.。
collocations: Mrs Brown; Mrs Smith; Dear Mrs Green。
commonMistake: Mrs 通常放在姓氏前；不要与 Miss（未婚女性称谓）或 Ms（不说明婚姻状况的称谓）混淆。

example.english: Mrs White brings a cake to the class party.
example.chinese: 怀特夫人给班级聚会带来一个蛋糕。

application.prompt: The letter is addressed to Mrs Brown, a married woman. Which title is used? A. Mrs B. Mr
application.solution: A。解析：Mrs 是对已婚女性的礼貌称呼，Mr 用于男性。

examTags: 词汇·不规则动词词形
语言运用·表达饮食活动
grammar: v. 吃；eat—ate—eaten—eating。可直接接食物作宾语，也可用 eat out 表示外出就餐。
collocations: eat breakfast; eat a piece of cake; eat out。
commonMistake: eat 的过去式是 ate，过去分词是 eaten；助动词 did 后用原形 eat。

example.english: We eat the birthday cake after dinner.
example.chinese: 我们晚饭后吃生日蛋糕。

application.prompt: Let's ___ the cake after we sing the birthday song. A. eat B. eats
application.solution: A。解析：Let's 后接动词原形，使用 eat。

examTags: 词汇·动词与名词
语言运用·表达祝愿
grammar: v. 希望；祝愿；n. 愿望；祝福。常见表达 wish sb. a happy birthday、make a wish、wish for sth.。
collocations: make a wish; wish you good luck; birthday wishes。
commonMistake: 祝某人生日快乐可说 wish sb. a happy birthday；不能把“祝愿某人”误写成 wish for sb.。

example.english: I wish my friend a happy birthday.
example.chinese: 我祝朋友生日快乐。

application.prompt: At the party, we ___ Grandma a happy birthday. A. wish B. hope
application.solution: A。解析：常用 wish sb. a happy birthday；hope 后不能直接接“某人 + 祝福内容”这种结构。

examTags: 词汇·职业与人物
阅读·根据工作职责识别职业
grammar: n. 护士；可数，复数 nurses。也可作 v. 照料、护理病人。
collocations: a nurse at a hospital; a school nurse; nurse a patient。
commonMistake: nurse 是照料病人的护士；patient 是病人，注意不要把职业和接受护理的人混淆。

example.english: The nurse helps the children feel better.
example.chinese: 护士帮助孩子们感觉好一些。

application.prompt: At the hospital, this worker cares for patients and helps the doctor. The worker is a ___. A. nurse B. patient
application.solution: A。解析：照料病人并协助医生的医护人员是 nurse（护士）。

examTags: 词汇·不规则动词与感官动词
听力·区分听见与倾听
grammar: v. 听见；hear—heard—heard—hearing。hear 强调声音进入耳朵；listen 通常表示主动倾听，后接 to。
collocations: hear a sound; hear from a friend; hear about the party。
commonMistake: hear 后可直接接听到的声音；listen 通常要加 to：hear music，但 listen to music。

example.english: I can hear the birthday song from the next room.
example.chinese: 我能从隔壁房间听到生日歌。

application.prompt: The music is loud, so I can ___ it from outside. A. hear B. listen
application.solution: A。解析：hear 后可直接接声音作宾语；listen 通常需要 listen to it。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与方位表达
听读·理解地点和动作信息
grammar: n. 门；可数，复数 doors。常用 open/close the door、at the door；敲门说 knock on/at the door。
collocations: open the door; knock on the door; at the front door。
commonMistake: 敲门常说 knock on/at the door；door 是可数名词，单数前通常有 a/the 或物主限定词。

example.english: Please knock on the door before you come in.
example.chinese: 请进来前先敲门。

application.prompt: Before entering the room, please knock on the ___. A. door B. card
application.solution: A。解析：进房间前敲的是 door（门）。
